# The packages of Factorlab (engine and factor library). ./setup.sh installs this file:
#     engine/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --require-hashes -r engine/requirements.txt
# Each entry pins one version and gives the sha256 hash of each file of that version on
# PyPI (all wheels and the source archive). pip install --require-hashes refuses a file
# with a different hash. The set resolves the same on Python 3.12 and 3.13, on macOS
# (arm64 and x86_64) and on Linux x86_64. The markers of the ccxt dependencies uvloop,
# orjson and coincurve are the markers that ccxt declares.
#
# On macOS x86_64, PyPI has no wheel of cryptography 50.0.2 (a ccxt dependency). There,
# pip builds it from the source archive, which needs a Rust compiler and OpenSSL.

# Packages that the code imports
